item.title: Stand gives way during Norwegian soccer game, sending Bodø/Glimt fans plunging to ground below
item.description: A Norwegian top-tier soccer match between Arctic Circle club Tromsø and Bodø/Glimt has been interrupted after a panel in the away fans’ stand gave way.

item.title: South Africa's ANC is humbled by its worst election results as it continues its decline
item.description: South Africa’s African National Congress is party facing its worst election results ever. Last week's local elections are a new low point for the party of the late Nelson Mandela after it received around 30% of the vote with 99% of results counted on Sunday.

item.title: Tens of thousands march in Amsterdam, pressing the Dutch government on Gaza and Israel
item.description: Tens of thousands of people, many dressed in red, have marched through Amsterdam, demanding the Dutch government take stronger action against Israel over Gaza.

item.title: At least 21 dead after boat carrying migrants sinks off Senegal coast, interior ministry says
item.description: At least 21 people died after a boat carrying migrants sank off Senegal's coast, according to the country's interior ministry.

item.title: Train collision in Egypt's Giza province injures 64 as crews rush to clear wreckage
item.description: Egyptian authorities say over 60 people were injured when a train traveling between Giza and Fayoum collided with another train from Cairo to Aswan.
